import numpy as np

# Compare L1_MLP write: baseline (r1) vs L1H0 ablated (r6)
r1 = np.load('/work/fwd/r1/run.npz')
r6 = np.load('/work/fwd/r6/run.npz')

# r1 inputs 0,1,5 correspond to our test inputs
baseline_l1mlp = r1['L1_MLP'][[0,1,5]]  # inputs 0,1,5 from r1
ablated_l1mlp = r6['L1_MLP']            # 3 inputs from r6

print("L1_MLP write comparison (baseline vs L1H0 ablated):")
for b in range(3):
    diff = np.abs(baseline_l1mlp[b] - ablated_l1mlp[b])
    print(f"\nInput {b}:")
    print(f"  Max diff: {diff.max():.4f}")
    print(f"  Mean diff: {diff.mean():.4f}")
    print(f"  L2 norm diff: {np.linalg.norm(diff):.4f}")
    print(f"  L2 norm baseline: {np.linalg.norm(baseline_l1mlp[b]):.4f}")

# Also check L1_MLP writes across positions for uniform case (input 2 = all 5s)
# If COMBINER, writes should differ per position (uses local token + max info)
# but all tokens are same so the difference should come only from position embedding
print("\n\nL1_MLP write variation across positions (uniform input, baseline):")
uniform_mlp = r1['L1_MLP'][5]  # uniform input [5,5,5,...,5]
norms = np.linalg.norm(uniform_mlp, axis=-1)
print(f"  L2 norms per position: {norms.round(3)}")

# Check variation across non-BOS positions
non_bos = uniform_mlp[1:]
diffs_from_pos1 = [np.linalg.norm(uniform_mlp[i] - uniform_mlp[1]) for i in range(1,10)]
print(f"  Diff from pos1 write: {[f'{d:.3f}' for d in diffs_from_pos1]}")
